rationale: Third-party bodily injury (neighbor's child) occurring on the policyholder's premises due to an unsafe condition (icy walkway), which is a classic liability claim under homeowners coverage.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child suffered a broken wrist after slipping on an icy walkway in front of the policyholder's house during an ice storm last week. Parents are discussing medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury liability claim requiring immediate adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
